title: The Snake Charmer
text: An old woman sits among a hundred snakes, playing a pipe, and they sway around her like grass in a wind. Her eyes are slit like theirs. She will teach the tune, for a price. The snakes turn their heads to look at you.

options.label: The quickest fingers learn her tune, whatever price she names.

outcomes.text: Snakes will not bite them now, nor most other poisons. They hum it in their sleep.

options.label: Pay her to clear the road, and keep your distance from the swaying heads.

outcomes.text: She plays, and the snakes part, every head turned to watch you pass.

options.label: The Leader steals her pipe. Let the snakes obey someone else.

outcomes.text: The music stops, and so does she. The snakes do not.
